sources.title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers / DINO (Caron et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Self-distillation without labels on ViT yields emergent properties absent in supervised ViTs/convnets: CLS-attention maps with explicit semantic-segmentation information and 78.3% kNN ImageNet top-1 (small ViT); momentum encoder + multi-crop + small patches matter; DINO ViT-Base reaches 80.1% linear-eval top-1.
Terminology discipline: ALWAYS 'DINO self-supervised' vs 'DINO detector' (VM-D011); CV2-DM-006 rule.
claims.context: Edition-level analytical synthesis by the Work operator (lineage/selection/boundary/contract judgment, not a literal statement of the cited source); structural home for edition rationale.

claims.text: Collapse avoidance requires BOTH centering (bias on teacher output only, EMA-updated) and sharpening (low teacher temperature); either missing collapses (KL->0 or dominated-dimension/uniform per H = h + D_KL decomposition).

Temperature direction: TEACHER is centered+sharpened with the SMALLER temperature (student tau_s=0.1 fixed; teacher tau_t linear warmup 0.04->0.07); momentum teacher lambda cosine 0.996->1 with stop-gradient (student-only SGD). The reverse (student sharpened, teacher smoothed) is factually wrong.
